Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.importer

Class ImporterManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.importer.ImporterManager
public class ImporterManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Importer REST API manager.

Requires Importer Extension plugin:

  • Download: https://sourceforge.net/projects/geoserver/files/GeoServer/2.28.2/extensions/geoserver-2.28.2-importer-plugin.zip/download
  • kartoza/geoserver Docker: STABLE_EXTENSIONS=importer-plugin

Verified against: GeoServer 2.28.2 / 2026-04-02 (Docker geoserver, STABLE_EXTENSIONS=importer-plugin)

Source:

  • gs-importer-rest-2.28.2.jar -> org/geoserver/importer/rest/ImportController.class
  • gs-importer-rest-2.28.2.jar -> org/geoserver/importer/rest/ImportTaskController.class
  • gs-importer-rest-2.28.2.jar -> org/geoserver/importer/rest/ImportDataController.class
